What is an Ionic Bond?
The strong force of attraction existing between two oppositely charged ions is called as
Ionic Bond.
The strong force of attraction existing between two oppositely charged ions is called as
Ionic Bond.
Then the question arises, what is an ion?
An ion is formed when an atom either loses an electron or gains an electron.
Why should an atom lose an electron?
Because atom is not stable.
They combine with other atoms to get the stability.
So in order to get stability, to get near a renewable configuration, atoms tends to lose
a gain electrons following octet rule.
What is octet rule?
Octet rule means a presence of eight electrons in the valentine shell is called as octet rule.
So atoms either lose are gain electrons to form ions and these ions are of two types.
One is cation and another one is anion.
What is cation?
When an atom loses an electron to get octet out of an electronic configuration, cation
is formed.
For example, sodium.
Sodium with atomic number 11 is having an electronic configuration.
One is 2, two is 2, two is 2, two is 6 and three is 1.
That means sodium is having a three shells in the first shell.
Sodium is having a two electrons, second shell.
Sodium is having eight electrons and in the third shell, sodium is having one electron.
But in the valentine shell, that is the last shell, sodium is having only one electron.
But to get stability, it needs a seven more electrons.
If it loses this electron, so if it loses this electron, it gets eight electrons in the
second shell, which is a stable.
So easily sodium loses this electron and form cation.
Because it is losing one electron, here the charge becomes plus one.
And in the case of anion, we are going to see anion.

In the second shell, eight electrons and in the third shell, seven electrons are present.

from sodium.

Sodium is donating the electron and chlorine is accepting that electron.
Complete transfer of electrons is taking place.
You can see how the sodium cation is formed and chlorine negative ion is from other days
anion.

number 3, you are having two shells in the first shell, two electrons in the second
shell, one electron and fluorine again here at atomic number 9, it is also having two
